raw.product_description: narma observes work patterns through desktop sensors, uses an "Intelligence Layer" to detect employee intent and business value of tasks, and an "Execution Layer" to generate and deploy AI agents for high-ROI opportunities. It focuses on the "Work Graph" to identify where AI can assist.
raw.what_makes_this_different: narma's unique approach is its three-layer architecture (Observe, Intelligence, Execution) that integrates work pattern observation, intent detection, and automated AI agent deployment, focusing on the "Work Graph" to pinpoint and prove AI's value in enterprise operations.
raw.one_liner: narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies to see, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale.
raw.thesis: narma is building an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies. The core innovation lies in its three-layer architecture: Observe, Intelligence, and Execution. It captures work patterns via desktop sensors (Observe), detects employee intent and business value of tasks while monitoring for "drift" (Intelligence Layer), and then automatically generates, deploys, and monitors AI agents for high-ROI opportunities (Execution Layer). This is designed for AI-first companies that struggle with quantifying AI savings, unreliable ROI measurements, and operational drift. narma aims to provide a single system to observe work, decide on AI interventions, and continuously build agents for "Continuous AI lift." The founder has not specified a particular goal for the venture (lifestyle, growth, or moonshot) and is currently at the idea stage, with a description of the concept but no mention of building or launching.

core_insight.if_wrong: The venture will fail if companies cannot accurately identify high-ROI opportunities for AI automation based on work patterns, or if the deployed agents do not deliver continuous, measurable 'AI lift'.
core_insight.source_excerpt: narma is an 'Enterprise Agentic Brain' designed for AI-first companies to see, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale. ... The system uses existing foundation models rather than building its own LLMs, focusing instead on the 'Work Graph' to reveal where resources are burned and where AI can intercept work mid-flow to provide assistance.
core_insight.why_different: narma focuses on observing work patterns across application usage, activity sequences, and time allocation to pinpoint AI automation opportunities and measure their impact, rather than just deploying general AI solutions.

market_data.why_better: narma provides a single system that observes how work happens, decides what AI should do next, and auto-builds agents continuously to ensure a 'Continuous AI lift.'
